rows.label: qst201508_msg0001
rows.name:
Mo? You want to know what
Toriri's employer is researching, mo?

rows.label: qst201508_msg0002
rows.name:
S-Sorry, but Toriri is only in
charge of his personal care, so
Toriri knows n-nothing, mo...

rows.label: qst201508_msg0003
rows.name:
I don't know a thing at all,
so please leave, mo!

rows.label: qst201508_msg0004
rows.name:
Mo-mo...?! Why do I feel so much
Nopon-style pressure, mo...?

rows.label: qst201508_msg0008
rows.name:
Will you keep what Toriri told you
a secret, mo?

rows.label: qst201508_msg0009
rows.name:
Toriri's employer is a
botanist named Lapacoll, mo.

rows.label: qst201508_msg0010
rows.name:
He's always cooped up in his
room, but he opens the door
only when Toriri comes, mo.

rows.label: qst201508_msg0011
rows.name:
The signal is to knock 16 times, mo.
My hand gets a little sore,
but you should try it, mo.

rows.label: qst201508_msg0012
rows.name:
What Toriri said is an
absolute secret, mo!

rows.label: qst201508_msg0014
rows.name:
Since I'm getting paid, I won't
leak any information, mo!
